Refused until Excel is asked: at a rate of -1 the growth is 0, and the forms of the identity that multiply by it give the payment -fv, -500 here, where those that divide by it give an Error Value (Search.cs, M1 and M6); PMT refuses it as PV refuses PV-013

Refused until Excel is asked: at a rate of -2, 1+rate is -1 and its square 1, so (1+rate)^nper-1 is 0 and every form of the identity divides by it; which Error Value Excel gives has not been observed (PMT-005's #NUM! at no periods may come from a check of nper rather than the division)

Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a third of a period at a rate below -1, the odd root of a negative 1+rate, as FV-017 found FV raises it; PMT raises 1+rate by the power PV and FV share, where e^(nper ln(1+rate)) would have no answer
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: ten periods before at a rate of -1, 0 to a negative power, #DIV/0! as FV-021 and PV-012 found it for FV and PV; PMT raises 1+rate by the power PV and FV share

Refused until Excel is asked: 1+rate raised past a double's range, where the payment itself is a number, -1000 exactly rounded; an evaluation that raises 1+rate in doubles gives #NUM!, one in an x87's wider exponent the payment
